title.zh: 每一分辨率下的静止：自然数的单位是一个损失的量子；单位可以细分时，按比例的损失连同最小尺度为被围住的交换、增长、下降、生起与止息定下界，最小花费为储备所推迟的终结定下界，缺少任一，各自无尽地继续
title.en: Rest at every resolution: the natural-number unit is a quantum of loss; where the unit may refine, loss in proportion with a least size bounds enclosed exchange, growth, falling, arising and ceasing, a least cost bounds the end a reserve defers, and without either each continues without end

claim.zh: 脊柱以一个固定单位的自然数计量，所以耗散每次交换至少损失一个单位；静止与开放的规律依赖这一量子。让单位跨过第 t 步分为 r t 个更细的单位（Flow.BalancesAt r；r 恒为一时就是 Balances，Flow.balancesAt_one），R 计每一步的单位数，以第 T 步的单位为一。损失的规律：从 T 起每步，q 乘余下的连同 k 个量子不多于 q 乘此前所有的时，自 T 起计到的量子不多于 q 乘该量在 T 的值（losses_invariant、losses_bound）；所以在细分分辨率下平衡且耗散时，从 T 起封闭的不重复家族损失至少 1/q 第 T 步单位的步不多于 q 乘其存量（Flow.quantum_bound），不复现（Flow.quantum_not_recurring）；单位固定时取用封闭家族停止（Flow.taking_stops）。按比例的损失：每个封闭家族得回的至多是从它取走的 q/(q+1) 时（Flow.DissipativeBy q；每个形成给回的至多是所取的 q/(q+1) 时如此，Flow.DissipatesBy.of_each），从 T 起封闭的家族中，取用至少 1/p 单位的形成逐个逐步计数，总数不多于 p(q+1) 乘其在 T 的存量（交换的规律，Flow.exchange_bound、Flow.exchange_not_recurring）；在有普查、关系项都体现、从 T 起每步被围住的世界中，增长至少 1/p 单位的关系项逐个逐步计数，总数不多于 p q 乘 T 时所立者的总水平（增长的规律，World.growth_bound），所以这样的增长不复现（World.growth_not_recurring），这一尺度的生起也不在任意晚的步发生（World.arising_not_recurring）；同样，下降至少 1/p 单位的关系项逐个逐步计数，总数不多于 p(q+1) 乘 T 时所立者的总水平（下降的规律，World.fall_bound、World.fall_not_recurring），所以立于至少 1/p 单位者的止息也不复现（World.ceasing_not_recurring）：在每一分辨率下，这一尺度的生起与止息都不复现（World.rests_at_resolution）。储备：每个活跃而不被支持的步至少花去 1/p 单位时（Web.CarriesAt），从 T 起不被支持的形成活跃的步不多于 p 乘其在 T 的储备（Web.CarriesAt.lasts）；脊柱的储备是 p 为一、单位固定的情形（Web.Carries.carriesAt），细分单位下只要求储备下降的读法在单位固定时就是脊柱的储备（Web.CarriesIn、Web.carriesIn_one）。每一尺度的最小损失：脊柱的耗散之下，取用至少 1/p 单位的形成都失去至少 1/m 单位时（Flow.LosesAtSize），从 T 起封闭的家族中这样的取用逐个逐步计数不多于 m 乘其在 T 的存量（Flow.exchange_bound_of_least_loss、Flow.exchange_not_recurring_of_least_loss）；逐个形成按比例的损失给出这样的最小损失（Flow.losesAtSize_of_each）。计数转移只需每一尺度的最小损失，计数关系项的增长需要更多。边界，每个见证都在无尽细分的单位下平衡并耗散：Asymptote 失去其所取用的全部，所以按每个比例耗散，恰在单位无尽地细分时无尽地被取用（rest_needs_quantum、Asymptote.exchange_recurs_iff）；Circulation 每步交换第 0 步的一整个单位，每步围住所立者，损失下一步的一个单位，不按任何比例耗散（exchange_needs_quantum）；Emission 有普查、关系项都体现、每步被围住、失去所取用的一半，每步生起一个新关系项，立于下一步的一个单位（arising_needs_quantum）；Alternation 有普查、关系项都体现、每步被围住，两侧轮流持有并生起第 0 步的一整个单位，不按任何比例耗散（arising_needs_proportion）；Dwindle 中单位每步减半，一个从不被支持的形成每步都活跃，储备在更细单位下每步下降而以第 0 步单位计趋于一个单位，对任何 p 都没有每步 1/p 单位的花费（reserve_needs_quantum）；Trickle 中单位每步分为四个，第 0 步的一整个单位在两侧之间由越来越多、越来越小的转移带过，每份失去下一步的两个单位，每一尺度都有最小损失，每个固定尺度的转移停止，而一整个单位在任意晚的步生起，不按任何比例耗散（growth_needs_proportion）。
claim.en: The spine counts amounts in natural numbers of one fixed unit, so dissipation loses at least a unit at every exchange, and the rest and openness laws rely on that quantum. Let the unit split into r t finer units across the step from t (Flow.BalancesAt r; with r constantly one it is Balances, Flow.balancesAt_one), and let R count the units of each step, the unit of step T being one. The loss law: where across each step from T on q times what remains together with k quanta is within q times what was there, the quanta counted since T number at most q times the quantity at T (losses_invariant, losses_bound); so, balanced at a refining resolution and dissipative, a family without repetition closed from T on loses at least 1/q of the unit of step T at no more steps than q times its stock (Flow.quantum_bound), and losing so does not recur (Flow.quantum_not_recurring); with the unit fixed, taking from a closed family stops (Flow.taking_stops). Loss in proportion: where every closed family gets back at most q/(q+1) of what is taken from it (Flow.DissipativeBy q; so where each formation gives back at most q/(q+1) of what it takes, Flow.DissipatesBy.of_each), the formations taking at least 1/p of the unit from a family closed from T on, counted formation by formation and step by step, number at most p(q+1) times its stock at T (the exchange law, Flow.exchange_bound, Flow.exchange_not_recurring); in a world with a census, embodied relata and every step from T on enclosed, the relata gaining at least 1/p of the unit, counted relatum by relatum and step by step, number at most p q times the total standing at T (the growth law, World.growth_bound), so such gains do not recur (World.growth_not_recurring) and nothing arises at that size at arbitrarily late steps (World.arising_not_recurring); likewise the relata falling by at least 1/p of the unit, counted relatum by relatum and step by step, number at most p(q+1) times the total standing at T (the fall law, World.fall_bound, World.fall_not_recurring), so nothing standing at least 1/p of the unit ceases at arbitrarily late steps (World.ceasing_not_recurring): at every resolution neither arising nor ceasing at that size recurs (World.rests_at_resolution). Reserve: where each active step beyond support costs at least 1/p of the unit (Web.CarriesAt), a formation unsupported from T on is active at most p times its reserve at T (Web.CarriesAt.lasts); the spine's reserve is the case of p one at a fixed unit (Web.Carries.carriesAt), and the reading in a refining unit that asks only that the reserve fall is, with the unit fixed, the spine's reserve (Web.CarriesIn, Web.carriesIn_one). A least loss at each size: with the spine's dissipation, where each formation taking at least 1/p of the unit loses at least 1/m of it (Flow.LosesAtSize), such takings from a family closed from T on, counted formation by formation and step by step, number at most m times its stock at T (Flow.exchange_bound_of_least_loss, Flow.exchange_not_recurring_of_least_loss); loss in proportion at each transfer gives such a least loss (Flow.losesAtSize_of_each). Counting transfers needs only a least loss at each size; counting what relata gain needs more. The boundaries, each witness balanced at a unit splitting without end and dissipative: Asymptote, losing all it takes and so dissipative by every share, is taken from without end exactly where the unit splits without end (rest_needs_quantum, Asymptote.exchange_recurs_iff); Circulation exchanges one whole unit of step 0 at every step, every step enclosed around what stands, losing one unit of the step after, and is dissipative by no share (exchange_needs_quantum); Emission, with a census, embodied relata, every step enclosed and half of what is taken lost, has a new relatum arise at every step, standing at one unit of the step after (arising_needs_quantum); Alternation, with a census, embodied relata and every step enclosed, has two sides hold and arise with one whole unit of step 0 in turn, and is dissipative by no share (arising_needs_proportion); in Dwindle, at a unit halving at each step, a formation never supported is active at every step, its reserve falling in the finer unit at each and tending to one unit of step 0, with no cost of 1/p of the unit at each step for any p (reserve_needs_quantum); in Trickle, at a unit quartering at each step, a whole unit of step 0 passes between two sides in ever more, ever smaller transfers, each losing two units of the step after, so every size has a least loss and transfers of each fixed size stop, yet a whole unit arises at arbitrarily late steps, with no share lost (growth_needs_proportion).

hypotheses.zh: 分辨率：R T = 1，从 T 起 R (t + 1) = r t · R t 且 0 < r t，即单位只细分；每一步的量仍是该步单位的自然数。这些是定理的假设，不是公理。
hypotheses.en: Resolution: R T = 1 and, from T on, R (t + 1) = r t · R t with 0 < r t, so the unit only splits; amounts at each step stay natural numbers of that step's unit. These are hypotheses of the theorems, not axioms.

hypotheses.zh: 按比例的损失（Flow.DissipativeBy q）：在每个跨过一步封闭的不重复家族上，家族得回的至多是从它取走的 q/(q+1)；每个参与的形成给回的至多是所取的 q/(q+1) 时如此（Flow.DissipatesBy.of_each），反之不然。它是前提，是脊柱一单位损失的无单位对应，不是推出的；作者读作家族的交换合起来的效率上界。
hypotheses.en: Loss in proportion (Flow.DissipativeBy q): on every family without repetition closed across a step, the family gets back at most q/(q+1) of what is taken from it; it holds where each formation taking part gives back at most q/(q+1) of what it takes (Flow.DissipatesBy.of_each), not conversely. It is a premise, the unit-free counterpart of the spine's one-unit loss, not derived; the author reads it as an upper bound on the efficiency of the family's exchanges taken together.

hypotheses.zh: 最小损失的交换律：脊柱的耗散（每个形成给回封闭家族的不多于所取），以及每一尺度的最小损失（Flow.LosesAtSize：取用至少 1/p 单位的形成失去至少 1/m 单位，m 不随步变化）。
hypotheses.en: The exchange law at a least loss: the spine's dissipation (each formation gives a closed family no more than it takes) and a least loss at each size (Flow.LosesAtSize: a formation taking at least 1/p of the unit loses at least 1/m of it, m the same at every step).

hypotheses.zh: 世界的规律：活动的普查、每个关系项都体现、从 T 起每步被围住，与静止定理（continued-change-needs-openness）相同。交换的规律只对从 T 起固定的封闭家族陈述。
hypotheses.en: The world laws: a census of activity, every relatum embodied and every step from T on enclosed, as in the rest theorem (continued-change-needs-openness). The exchange law is stated for a fixed family closed from T on.

hypotheses.zh: 储备的规律：从 T 起不被支持；活动可判定。最小花费（每个活跃的步至少 1/p 单位）是前提，是脊柱一单位下降的无单位对应。
hypotheses.en: The reserve law: unsupported from T on; activity decidable. The least cost (at least 1/p of the unit at each active step) is a premise, the unit-free counterpart of the spine's one-unit fall.

correspondence.zh: 单位固定时的静止定理（continued-change-needs-openness）是 r = 1 并带脊柱一单位损失的情形；本结果说明那里的损失是由单位承载的一个量子，并给出每一分辨率下都成立的规律。作者的读法（AI 论证）：以第 T 步的单位计，所立者的总水平是一个有理量；细分单位以更细的分辨率表示量，而不改动力学；按比例的损失是效率的上界；1/p 是计数变化所用的尺度。在这一读法下，有界效率之下被围住的生成，任何固定尺度的都会停止；在围住之内只能以越来越细或越来越接近无损的方式继续。所以“生起不息需要开放”不依赖表示的形式是：固定尺度的生起不息需要开放，或需要损失的比例趋于零。这回答了 continued-change-needs-openness 的下一步“带比率或连续量的总水平”中有理量与离散步的部分；连续时间与实数量仍开放。计数转移只需每一尺度的最小损失；计数关系项得到、失去、开始或终结的，需要对家族的比例，因为一整个单位可以由越来越多、越来越小的转移带过（Trickle）：只有损失随所转移的量成比例，分割才不能把损失分没。读法属于 Ren。
correspondence.en: The rest theorem with a fixed unit (continued-change-needs-openness) is the case r = 1 with the spine's one-unit loss; this result shows that the loss there is a quantum carried by the unit and gives the laws holding at every resolution. The author's reading (an AI argument): counted in the unit of step T, the total standing is a rational quantity; refining the unit represents amounts at finer resolution without changing the dynamics; loss in proportion is an upper bound on efficiency; 1/p is the size at which change is counted. On this reading, with bounded efficiency, enclosed generation of any fixed size stops, and inside an enclosure it can continue only ever finer or ever closer to lossless. So the form of ‘arising without end needs openness’ that does not depend on the representation is: arising without end at a fixed size needs openness, or a share of loss tending to zero. This answers, for rational amounts and discrete steps, the next step of continued-change-needs-openness, ‘total standing with rates or continuous amounts’; continuous time and real amounts remain open. Counting transfers needs only a least loss at each size; counting what relata gain, lose, begin or end needs the family's share, since a whole unit can pass in ever more, ever smaller transfers (Trickle): only a loss in proportion to what is transferred cannot be split away. The readings are Ren's.

detail.zh: 复用所立者的普查与其存量（Web.StandingCensus、Web.StandingCensus.stock_eq、World.standingCensus）、围住所立者的步（Flow.AroundStanding、Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding_not_not）与 exposed 的持有者（Exposed.stands_iff、Exposed.holder_one）；边界定理的前提对照 World.rests_enclosed、World.arising_opens 与 World.exchange_stops。
detail.en: Reuses the census of what stands and its stock (Web.StandingCensus, Web.StandingCensus.stock_eq, World.standingCensus), steps enclosed around what stands (Flow.AroundStanding, Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding_not_not) and the holder of exposed (Exposed.stands_iff, Exposed.holder_one); the boundary theorems match the premises of World.rests_enclosed, World.arising_opens and World.exchange_stops.

output.zh: 跨过围住所立者的步，所立者的总水平等于围住它的家族的存量；被围住的步不能被否定为围住所立者。
output.en: Across a step enclosed around what stands, the total standing equals the stock of the enclosing family; an enclosed step cannot be refuted to be enclosed around what stands.

input.zh: 在细分分辨率下，所立者的总水平不上升，每个至少 1/p 单位的增长使它至少损失 1/(p q) 单位。
input.en: At a refining resolution the total standing does not rise, and each gain of at least 1/p of the unit makes it lose at least 1/(p q) of the unit.

conditions.zh: 活动的普查；关系项都体现；从 T 起每步被围住；细分分辨率下的平衡；按比例的损失。
conditions.en: A census of activity; every relatum embodied; every step from T on enclosed; balance at a refining resolution; loss in proportion.

detail.zh: 复用耗散与封闭家族（Flow.DissipatesOn、Flow.Dissipative、Flow.ClosedAt、Flow.Enclosed）、被耗散的家族的补给与取用者不多于其取用（DissipatesOn.replenishment_takers）、有限关系项时每步被围住（Flow.enclosed_of_finite）与支撑之间的总和比较（total_le_of_support）；单位固定时的情形对照 Flow.Balances.taking_ceases。
detail.en: Reuses dissipation and closed families (Flow.DissipatesOn, Flow.Dissipative, Flow.ClosedAt, Flow.Enclosed), that a family dissipated on has replenishment and takers within its uptake (DissipatesOn.replenishment_takers), that with finitely many relata every step is enclosed (Flow.enclosed_of_finite), and the comparison of totals between supports (total_le_of_support); the fixed-unit case matches Flow.Balances.taking_ceases.

output.zh: 被耗散的家族的补给连同取用者不多于其取用。
output.en: A family dissipated on has its replenishment together with its takers within its uptake.

input.zh: 在细分分辨率下，存量连同取用者不多于 r t 乘此前的存量（Flow.BalancesAt.lowers）。
input.en: At a refining resolution, the stock together with the takers is within r t times the stock before (Flow.BalancesAt.lowers).

conditions.zh: 细分分辨率下的平衡；耗散；封闭的不重复家族。
conditions.en: Balance at a refining resolution; dissipation; a closed family without repetition.

detail.zh: 复用储备 Web.Carries；Web.Carries.carriesAt 说明脊柱的储备是 p 为一、单位固定时的每一分辨率下的储备，Web.carriesIn_one 说明细分单位下的读法在单位固定时就是它；Web.CarriesAt.lasts 是 Web.Carries.lasts 在每一分辨率下的形式。
detail.en: Reuses the reserve Web.Carries; Web.Carries.carriesAt shows the spine's reserve is the reserve at every resolution with p one at a fixed unit, and Web.carriesIn_one that the reading in a refining unit is it when the unit is fixed; Web.CarriesAt.lasts is the form of Web.Carries.lasts at every resolution.

output.zh: 不被支持的步上储备不上升，活跃时下降。
output.en: Across an unsupported step the reserve does not rise, and falls where the formation is active.

input.zh: 不被支持的步上储备在更细单位下不上升，活跃时至少下降 1/p 单位。
input.en: Across an unsupported step the reserve does not rise in the finer unit, and falls by at least 1/p of the unit where the formation is active.

conditions.zh: 从 T 起不被支持；单位只细分；活动可判定。
conditions.en: Unsupported from T on; the unit only refines; activity decidable.

detail.zh: 那里被围住为变化定下界（以单位计）；本结果在每一分辨率下为至少 1/p 单位的增长与取用定下界，以按比例的损失代替单位的量子。
detail.en: There enclosure bounds change, counted in the unit; this result bounds gains and taking of at least 1/p of the unit at every resolution, with loss in proportion in place of the unit's quantum.

detail.zh: 计划 R1：表示的范围之一，量的单位；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Plan R1: one dimension of the representation's scope, the unit of amounts; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: Asymptote：失去所取用的全部，按每个比例耗散，池每步封闭，取用者每步受支持；恰在单位无尽地细分时取用无尽（Asymptote.exchange_recurs_iff），所取用的缩小到每个量子之下。所以最小尺度不能去掉。
detail.en: Asymptote: losing all it takes, dissipative by every share, the pool closed and the drawer supported at every step; taking continues without end exactly where the unit splits without end (Asymptote.exchange_recurs_iff), what is taken shrinking below every quantum. So the least size cannot be dropped.

detail.zh: Circulation：所立者被列出、平衡于减半的单位、耗散、每步围住所立者，每步交换第 0 步的一整个单位；由交换的规律，它不按任何比例耗散（Circulation.not_dissipativeBy）。所以单位固定时交换的静止（World.exchange_stops）依赖量子，而按比例的损失不能去掉。
detail.en: Circulation: what stands listed, balanced at a halving unit, dissipative, every step enclosed around what stands, one whole unit of step 0 exchanged at every step; by the exchange law it is dissipative by no share (Circulation.not_dissipativeBy). So the exchange's rest with a fixed unit (World.exchange_stops) relies on the quantum, and loss in proportion cannot be dropped.

detail.zh: Emission：满足 World.rests_enclosed 的全部前提，只是平衡在减半的单位下，并按比例耗散（给回所取用的一半），每步生起一个新关系项，立于下一步的一个单位。所以静止定理依赖量子，按比例的损失没有最小尺度时也不足够。
detail.en: Emission: meets every premise of World.rests_enclosed but with balance at a halving unit, and is dissipative in proportion (giving back half of what it takes), with a new relatum arising at every step, standing at one unit of the step after. So the rest theorem relies on the quantum, and loss in proportion without a least size does not suffice.

detail.zh: Alternation：满足 World.rests_enclosed 的全部前提，只是平衡在减半的单位下，两侧轮流生起第 0 步的一整个单位；由增长的规律，它不按任何比例耗散（Alternation.not_dissipativeBy）。所以最小尺度没有按比例的损失时也不足够。
detail.en: Alternation: meets every premise of World.rests_enclosed but with balance at a halving unit, the two sides arising with one whole unit of step 0 in turn; by the growth law it is dissipative by no share (Alternation.not_dissipativeBy). So a least size without loss in proportion does not suffice.

detail.zh: Dwindle：单位每步减半，一个从不被支持的形成每步都活跃，储备以当步单位计为 2^t + 1，在更细单位下每步下降（Dwindle.carriesIn），以第 0 步单位计从上方趋于一个单位，永不到零；对任何 p，每个活跃的步不都花去 1/p 单位（Dwindle.not_carriesAt、reserve_needs_quantum）。单位固定时这样的储备就是脊柱的储备（Web.carriesIn_one），由 Web.Carries.lasts 不能如此。所以储备推迟终结而不逃脱依赖量子，每一分辨率下要每步的最小花费。
detail.en: Dwindle: at a unit halving at each step, a formation never supported is active at every step, its reserve, 2^t + 1 in the unit of step t, falling in the finer unit at each step (Dwindle.carriesIn) and tending from above to one unit of step 0, never reaching zero; for no p does each active step cost 1/p of the unit (Dwindle.not_carriesAt, reserve_needs_quantum). With the unit fixed such a reserve is the spine's (Web.carriesIn_one), which Web.Carries.lasts forbids. So that a reserve defers the end without escaping it relies on the quantum, and at every resolution needs a least cost at each step.

detail.zh: Trickle：单位每步分为四个；两侧轮流持有第 0 步的一整个单位，第 t 步由 2^t 个水平为零的转移者分成 2^t 份交给另一侧，每份失去下一步的两个单位。它有普查、关系项都体现、平衡、耗散、每步被围住；每一尺度都有最小损失（Trickle.losesAtEverySize），每个固定尺度的转移停止（Trickle.exchange_stops）；一整个单位在任意晚的步生起，不按任何比例耗散（Trickle.not_dissipativeBy、growth_needs_proportion）。所以每一尺度的最小损失给出交换的规律，不给出增长的规律。转移者不活跃；要求只有活跃者取用的变体没有构造。
detail.en: Trickle: at a unit quartering at each step, two sides hold one whole unit of step 0 in turn, and at step t it passes to the other side in 2^t parts carried by 2^t carriers standing at nothing, each part losing two units of the step after. It has a census, embodied relata, balance, dissipation and every step enclosed; every size has a least loss (Trickle.losesAtEverySize) and transfers of each fixed size stop (Trickle.exchange_stops); a whole unit arises at arbitrarily late steps, with no share lost (Trickle.not_dissipativeBy, growth_needs_proportion). So a least loss at each size gives the exchange law but not the growth law. The carriers are not active; a variant in which only active formations take is not constructed.

limitations.zh: 离散步；量是细分后的有理数，单位不变粗，不含实数量与连续时间；界是否可达未证；交换的规律只对从 T 起固定的封闭家族陈述，没有以变化的围住读于世界；按比例的损失与储备的最小花费是前提，作为物理对应的根据未审；比对家族的比例更弱而仍给出增长的规律的前提没有陈述；Trickle 的转移者不活跃；其余见证只有一两个关系项，说明前提彼此独立，不描述实际系统；“不复现”是复现的否定，不是某步之后不再发生；不含伦理谓词；尚无独立审查；名称与读法属于 Ren。
limitations.en: Discrete steps; amounts are rationals by refinement, the unit never coarsening, with neither real amounts nor continuous time; whether the bounds are attained is not proved; the exchange law is stated for a fixed family closed from T on, not read of worlds with changing enclosures; loss in proportion and the reserve's least cost are premises whose physical warrant is not reviewed; no premise weaker than the family's share is stated that still gives the growth law; the carriers of Trickle are not active; the other witnesses have one or two relata and show the premises independent, not describing actual systems; ‘does not recur’ is a negated recurrence, not a step after which nothing happens; no ethical predicate; not yet independently reviewed; names and readings are Ren's.
